description: Agent Food Safety Records: submit sanitation and cleaning records with the schedule, safety data sheets and pre-operation inspections they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each scheduled cleaning with its id, reference, area, task and the moment due; each sanitation log entry with its id, reference, the scheduled cleaning it completes, area, the moment cleaned, its status (completed, incomplete or failed) and the chemical used; each re-clean or verification with its id, reference, the log entry it answers, its kind and the moment recorded; each chemical in the sanitation record with its id, reference and name; each safety data sheet on file with its id, reference and the chemical it covers; each pre-operation inspection with its id, reference, area, the moment inspected and the result. The signed report gives the cleanings and the schedule, each scheduled cleaning due by the reading moment against a completed record, each sanitation failure against a re-clean or verification behind it, each chemical in the sanitation record against a safety data sheet on file, and each pre-operation inspection recorded as passed against the sanitation log for its day, and counts them, and names divergent sanitation records: a scheduled cleaning with no completed record, a sanitation failure recorded with no re-clean or verification entry behind it, a chemical in the sanitation record with no safety data sheet on file, and a pre-operation inspection recorded as passed on a day the sanitation log shows incomplete; then a log entry naming a scheduled cleaning the schedule does not hold and a re-clean naming a log entry the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No scheduled cleanings and no sanitation log entries, or a schedule with no reading moment, leaves those points unverified. Schedule entries, log entries and re-cleans match by letters and digits, chemicals and areas compare by their words without case or punctuation, a cleaning due on or before the reading moment needs a completed entry naming it, and a passed pre-operation inspection is read against the log entries for its day and area. This reads whether every cleaning the schedule calls for was done, every failure was re-cleaned and verified, and every chemical has its sheet. Verdict food_sanitation_divergent, food_sanitation_partial, food_sanitation_unverified or food_sanitation_consistent. POST /api/food-sanitation-check. Reads the food safety records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it inspects no facility, takes no temperature, contacts no regulator or auditor and issues no certification, which stay with the business, its food safety team, its regulators and its auditors, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Food Safety Records reads a food business’s own safety records: food safety and HACCP plan records, critical-control-point and temperature monitoring logs, health inspection and third-party audit reports, recall and traceability records, supplier approval and receiving records, sanitation records, allergen and labeling records and corrective action records, each against the monitoring, inspection and corrective-action records, the corrective actions and the schedule, the plan’s limits and equipment, the lot traceability and inventory records, the supplier approvals and certificates, the cleaning schedule and safety data sheets, the formulation and production records or the deviations and verifications on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the food: what the plan requires, what the logs show, what the inspectors found, and whether the fixes and the traceability hold up; the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods as trade records, and the Agent Automotive family reads vehicle records, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-food-safety-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-food-safety-records/.
